title: Nutty Bao Buns
description: Sweet, fluffy bao buns filled with a crunchy nutty filling, perfect for a snack or dessert.

ingredients.name: bao dough
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores or online

instructions: Combine bao dough ingredients and knead for 10 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a ball.
Use a rolling pin to flatten each ball into a disk.
Mix nutty filling ingredients and set aside.
Place a tablespoon of nutty filling in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a bun.
Use a fork to crimp the edges.
Brush the tops with egg wash.
Bake at 375°F (190°C) for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
